proof_attempt_summary: Discovery discharged uniform Gaussian calibration, variance calibration, local power and total computation for the declared heat-reference Hessian diagnostic, including expanded entropy schedules. Math and rubric panels passed, but the projected 5.8 ceiling capped the achieved tier at incremental: no actual STE-estimator expansion/transfer or practical implementation was delivered. tldr: The original-record causal Hessian equality diagnostic has uniform Gaussian calibration on the full smooth four-dimensional periodic heat-reference model, including nonconstant marginal densities and conditional heterogeneity. The proved logarithmic trace supplies the positive observable coefficient \(v(P)=(32\pi^2)^{-1}\int(w_P/\rho)^2dy\). The general critical option is eventual \(\varepsilon_N=N^{-1/5}\ell_N^{1/4}h_N\), where a fixed total public algorithm returns exact rationals \(h_N\ge1\), \(h_N\to\infty\), and \(N^4/(\ell_N^5h_N^{20})\to\infty\). Equivalently its eventual \(L_N\) diverges; no comparison with \(\log N\) is required. Both \(h_N=1+\lfloor\log_2\ell_N\rfloor\) and \(h_N=\lfloor N^{1/10}\rfloor\) are explicit witnesses. The unchanged primitive-derived finite positive pilot and total numerical certificate attain uniformly exact limiting size \(.10\). Each fixed rational \(0<\alpha<1/5\) and \(\beta>1/4\) remains available. Smooth contrasts at \(L_N^{1/4}/\sqrt n\) have a computable Green-energy shift; bounded root-sample-size smooth contrasts have power \(.10\). Critical multipliers that do not diverge, including bounded multipliers at logarithmic exponent \(1/4\), the unslowed \(N^{-1/5}\) endpoint, faster shrinking schedules, and necessity or sharpness of the sufficient learned-reference loss and neighborhood remain in \texttt{oeq:maximal-learned-entropy-window}. A nonvanishing upper envelope is not evidence of calibration failure.
gap: Agarwal and Luedtke establish fixed-entropy causal null chaos and fixed finite-grid aggregation. At the four-dimensional Green boundary, the squared Hessian spectrum diverges, so fixed Hilbert--Schmidt kernel convergence cannot justify shrinking-entropy calibration. Generic weighted Weyl and changing-kernel probability theorems leave a uniform Sinkhorn transfer, the observed-law covariance coefficient and an attaining continuum computation certificate to establish.
fill: A uniform shifted-resolvent comparison, weighted logarithmic trace and original-record martingale defect support a learned Gaussian equality test with exact asymptotic size. A total finite residual and composition certificate and a certified weighted Green-energy map are posed as explicit construction questions.
